flawless: Keld does not bleed for weaklings. Today it did not bleed at all.
My warriors fell gladly, and every death brought you lower. That is the way of Keld.
The fires of the Flarg have scorched me worse than your whole deck did.
solid: You made me bleed. Good! A Keldon remembers every wound with joy.
You fought with half a heart. I could feel you holding back, and Keld felt it too.
close: Hah! My fist is broken and my heart is pounding. That was a true Keldon battle!
I saw the Necropolis open its gates for me. Not today, stranger. Not today.
